snippet.title: Comet Force Pre-alpha Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Comet Force on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2954690/Comet_Force

Comet Force is a Space Arena Shooter Action Roguelike. Build and develop your camp, recruit to compose and grow your troop, collect upgrades and unique effects, and fight ever more waves of enemies. Will your troop remain strong enough to survive until the end?
